The short version: Colaba is the budget option in TikTok Shop outreach software, roughly $59 to $249 a month, built for high-volume creator invites, and you run it. Tokgency is a managed agency that runs the full program and is accountable for GMV. Colaba optimizes for message volume; Tokgency optimizes for sales.

Colaba's whole pitch is volume, and that is exactly where experienced operators say brands go wrong. One founder whose brand is on track for $35 million on TikTok Shop this year put it plainly: most brands "blast out thousands of affiliate DMs, hope something sticks, and wonder why growth plateaus," and the fix is to "go deep on affiliate relationships, not wide" (@brock_mammoser on X). Cheap bulk outreach optimizes for the blasting he is warning against.

What Colaba is

Colaba focuses on the outreach bottleneck at the lowest published price in the category. It offers:

  • Bulk creator invites at scale
  • CRM messaging and advanced filters
  • Multi-shop support and an analytics dashboard

At roughly $59 to $249/mo, it is the cheapest way to send a lot of invites. That is its strength and also its ceiling: volume, not strategy or management.

What Tokgency is

Tokgency is TikTok-only and done-for-you. We recruit, seed, negotiate, brief, manage, amplify, and report, and we own the GMV. The creator finder is available for self-serve search, but the core is a managed program.

Side by side

Colaba Tokgency
Model Cheap bulk outreach software Managed agency (+ tool)
Optimizes for Messages sent GMV driven
Pricing ~$59 to $249/mo Flexible, commission-friendly
Strategy and management You Us
Best when You want cheap volume You want the outcome

Bulk invites are easy to buy and easy to waste. Blasting thousands of creators without targeting, briefs, or follow-through produces noise, not GMV. The daily judgment, who to target, what to offer, which winners to scale, is exactly what cheap outreach tools leave to you.

When Colaba is the better pick

  • You are extremely price-sensitive and want a lot of invites.
  • You already have the strategy and just need cheap reach.
  • You run multiple shops and want low-cost multi-shop tooling.

When Tokgency is the better pick

  • You would rather have 25 productive creators than 2,500 ignored invites.
  • You want the program managed, not just messages sent.
  • You want accountability for GMV.

More on choosing between cheap tools, full software, and a team in DIY, software, or agency.

Want quality over blast volume? Book a call, or search creators who actually sell in your niche.
